capabilities: Write recipes as fenced kaper YAML blocks in markdown notes
Render recipe blocks as formatted cards with ingredients, steps, times, tags, and images
Edit recipes through a form with drag-and-drop ingredient reordering
Cook step-by-step with ingredient checklists and servings scaling
Open recipes in the Kaper web app
extras: Mobile support is read-only (preview and Cook Mode); creating, converting, and form editing are desktop-only. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It makes no network requests; remote image URLs are the only external loads.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to store, render, and follow a recipe inside a plain markdown note.

relations.evidence: The same .md file opens in this plugin, in the Kaper web app at kaper.me
and in the Kaper desktop app (in development). There's no sync layer to set up.

summary: Recipe manager that stores recipes as kaper YAML blocks in markdown notes, with inline preview, form editing, and step-by-step Cook Mode with servings scaling.
